BFA.note: Document states no rule, draft or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: The government's secretary general presented LegiChat, a platform that eases access to the country's legislative and regulatory texts, at the national AI campaign launch at Joseph Ki-Zerbo University on 28 October 2025, according to TIC Magazine BF.

BFA.note: Health, agriculture and water/energy AI tools are only roadmap use cases; the document says none is yet deployed.

facts.fact: A national workshop convened by SP-IVTEN in Ouagadougou on 17 June 2026 validated the national AI roadmap 2026-2030, with six work areas, per TIC Magazine BF; no cabinet approval is stated.

CITADEL, the AI centre attached to the Virtual University, built a French-Mooré voice and text translator and a corpus of 83,000 French-Mooré sentence pairs for training language models, per TIC Magazine BF.

BFA.note: Document states nothing on who runs government systems.

facts.fact: CITADEL, the Virtual University's AI centre, had two Mooré-language contributions accepted at the international LoResLM workshop in 2026, per TIC Magazine BF.

The national AI roadmap 2026-2030 was drawn up with administrations, the private sector, universities, civil society, diaspora and funders, and was validated at a national workshop on 17 June 2026, per TIC Magazine BF.

BFA.note: Document states no startup law, strategy or fund.

facts.fact: TIC Magazine BF describes OuagaLab (2012), La Fabrique (2014) and Beoogo Lab (2013) as operating support structures that train makers and accompany entrepreneurs, though not AI incubators.

BFA.note: All named hubs are in Ouagadougou; no cities or park stated.
